reproduced_gap.name: compaction result is not part of the durable replay transaction
exact_current_behavior: V15 would strictly persist awaiting_compacted_history before ephemeral TurnAffinity
compact_payload(completion.text, turn_key) is still constructed/returned after that durable lifecycle publication
the exact compact payload is not persisted in ConversationSegmentStore
after a crash between durable publication and client receipt, a retry after restart has no durable compact result and re-enters provider compaction
reproduced_gap.why_blocking: A retry can produce a different compacted checkpoint from the one logically committed before the crash. This breaks Codex lifecycle idempotency and can advance the Notion thread twice for one compaction request.

v16_required_boundary.ordering: provider result -> canonical compact_payload -> strict atomic ConversationSegment publication including the exact compact payload/fingerprint -> ephemeral TurnAffinity -> client
retry_rules: exact fingerprint + durable payload => return exact stored compact payload, provider call_count remains 1
fingerprint present in stale replay fingerprints => fail closed, never recompact
durable write failure => no TurnAffinity and no client compact result
crash after durable write but before client response => restart retry returns exact stored payload without provider call
distinct turn_id with the same input => new request, provider may run
